nodes.label: Tax salience
nodes.description: The prominence or visibility of taxes to taxpayers when making economic decisions. Appears as a cause in 1 claim.

nodes.label: Public sector employment
nodes.description: Employment within government-owned or controlled organizations. Appears as a cause in 1 claim.

nodes.label: Children and fertility
nodes.description: The presence, number, or addition of children in a household. Appears as a cause in 14 claims.

nodes.label: Grandparental labor supply
nodes.description: The relative labor supply or employment status of maternal versus paternal grandparents. Appears as a cause in 2 claims.

nodes.label: Parental death shock
nodes.description: The occurrence and timing of a sudden first parental death. Appears as a cause in 9 claims.

nodes.label: Liquidity constraints
nodes.description: The inability of an individual or firm to raise cash quickly to meet financial obligations or opportunities. Appears as a cause in 1 claim.

nodes.label: Firm size
nodes.description: The scale of a firm, typically measured by its number of employees. Appears as a cause in 1 claim.

nodes.label: Gender gap in earnings
nodes.description: The difference in earnings between men and women, including child penalties. Appears as an outcome in 3 claims.

nodes.label: Gender gap in hours worked
nodes.description: The difference in weekly hours worked between men and women. Appears as an outcome in 1 claim.

nodes.label: Gender gap in labor force participation
nodes.description: The difference in labor force participation rates between men and women. Appears as an outcome in 1 claim.

nodes.label: Gender gap in wage rates
nodes.description: The difference in hourly wage rates between men and women. Appears as an outcome in 1 claim.

nodes.label: Relative probability of working in a family-friendly firm
nodes.description: The probability of women working in family-friendly firms relative to men. Appears as an outcome in 1 claim.

nodes.label: Relative probability of becoming manager
nodes.description: The probability of women becoming managers relative to men. Appears as an outcome in 1 claim.

nodes.label: Relative occupational rank
nodes.description: The occupational rank of women relative to men. Appears as an outcome in 1 claim.

nodes.label: Relative probability of working in the public sector
nodes.description: The probability of women working in the public sector relative to men. Appears as an outcome in 1 claim.

nodes.label: Mental health service use
nodes.description: The utilization of mental health treatments, prescriptions, or psychological assistance. Appears as an outcome in 4 claims.

nodes.label: Opioid prescriptions
nodes.description: The prescription and use of opioid medications. Appears as an outcome in 2 claims.

nodes.label: Health shock
nodes.description: An unexpected and severe adverse health event.

nodes.label: Fatal health shock
nodes.description: A sudden health event resulting in death. Appears as a cause in 7 claims.

nodes.label: Severe nonfatal health shock
nodes.description: A severe health event that does not result in death. Appears as a cause in 3 claims.

nodes.label: Legal tax avoidance
nodes.description: The use of legal methods to minimize the amount of income tax owed. Appears as an outcome in 1 claim.

nodes.label: Capital income
nodes.description: Income derived from capital assets, such as dividends, interest, or capital gains. Appears as an outcome in 3 claims.

nodes.label: Household post-transfer income
nodes.description: The total disposable income of a household after receiving government transfers. Appears as an outcome in 1 claim.

nodes.label: Reported income
nodes.description: Income reported to tax authorities, categorized by reporting source.

nodes.label: Self-reported income
nodes.description: Income reported to tax authorities directly by the taxpayer. Appears as an outcome in 2 claims.

nodes.label: Third-party reported income
nodes.description: Income reported to tax authorities by a third party, such as an employer. Appears as an outcome in 2 claims.

nodes.label: Income shifting
nodes.description: The practice of moving income across tax periods or categories to minimize tax liability. Appears as an outcome in 9 claims.

nodes.label: Tax evasion
nodes.description: The illegal non-payment or underpayment of tax. Appears as an outcome in 2 claims.

nodes.label: Taxable income
nodes.description: The amount of income used to calculate an individual's or household's income tax liability. Appears as an outcome in 3 claims.

nodes.label: Within-firm earner rank
nodes.description: An individual's relative earnings position within their employing firm. Appears as a cause in 1 claim.

nodes.label: Earnings
nodes.description: The financial compensation received by an individual in exchange for their labor. Appears as an outcome in 17 claims.

nodes.label: Labor supply
nodes.description: The amount of individual effort or time offered for paid work, including participation and hours. Appears as an outcome in 7 claims.

nodes.label: Occupational employment
nodes.description: Employment levels across different occupational categories.

nodes.label: Employment in high-wage occupations
nodes.description: Employment in occupations that pay high average wages. Appears as an outcome in 4 claims.

nodes.label: Employment in low-wage occupations
nodes.description: Employment in occupations that pay low average wages. Appears as an outcome in 3 claims.

nodes.label: Employment in mid-wage occupations
nodes.description: Employment in occupations that pay middle-range average wages. Appears as an outcome in 4 claims.

nodes.label: Tax enforcement
nodes.description: Actions taken by tax authorities to monitor or enforce compliance.

nodes.label: Tax audits
nodes.description: Formal examinations of tax returns by tax authorities. Appears as a cause in 2 claims.

nodes.label: Threat-of-audit letters
nodes.description: Communications from tax authorities warning of a potential audit. Appears as a cause in 2 claims.

nodes.label: Net-of-tax rate
nodes.description: The share of income kept by the taxpayer after taxes (1 minus the marginal tax rate). Appears as a cause in 6 claims.

nodes.label: Net-of-tax rate on capital income
nodes.description: The net-of-tax rate applied specifically to capital gains or investment income. Appears as a cause in 3 claims.

nodes.label: Net-of-tax rate on labor income
nodes.description: The net-of-tax rate applied specifically to labor earnings. Appears as a cause in 10 claims.

nodes.label: Import competition exposure
nodes.description: Exposure to increased foreign trade competition, specifically from the removal of import quotas. Appears as a cause in 11 claims.
